instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova is a diversified holding company with operating businesses spanning industrial packaging, specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. The portfolio consists of 6 operating companies with combined revenues exceeding €180M. The central corporate team manages complex strategy, M&A, and group finance, focusing on integrating cross-portfolio digital transformation while maintaining stringent regulatory compliance across global supply chains.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company currently operates without a formal innovation process; problems are solved ad-hoc by the most directly affected team members. There is no dedicated budget or structured ideation track record, meaning innovation has historically been driven purely by operational necessity rather than strategic foresight.
answers.strategicGoals: Nova aims to double revenue within three years through aggressive geographic expansion into new markets and the launch of a direct-to-consumer channel alongside B2B distribution. The top priority is identifying scalable customer acquisition channels and building operational capacity that supports rapid volume growth without compromising quality or margins.
answers.additionalContext: While the organization possesses significant capital, deep talent pools in AI/ML and cloud engineering, and existing technology infrastructure, internal processes are currently optimized for stability and risk management rather than speed. Navigating procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security reviews remains a critical hurdle for any rapid change initiative.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Supply Chain Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing AI/ML centers to predict demand fluctuations in industrial packaging and chemical raw material sourcing can incrementally reduce operational waste and improve logistics efficiency.

first_actions: Pilot ML model on one core product line's inventory forecasting
Establish a dedicated cross-functional task force (Tech, Ops) for pilot
Develop ROI model showing cost savings in Q3
resources_needed: Hire one specialized Data Scientist/ML Engineer contractor
Access to existing cloud compute resources
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a minimum 8% reduction in inventory holding costs within 6 months.
milestones: Month 2: Model training complete and validated against historical data.
Month 4: Operational integration of the pilot model into daily procurement workflow.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Localized Micro-Manufacturing Hubs (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Given the strategic priority of growth and high competitive pressure, establishing small, localized manufacturing hubs near major customer bases could drastically cut lead times for custom packaging solutions and address regional regulatory changes.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on two key target geographic markets
Secure strategic partnerships with local logistics providers
resources_needed: Allocate €3M from the 12% innovation budget for initial setup grants
Engage external consulting firm specializing in regulatory compliance
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure operational readiness and revenue contribution of >5% from new hub sales within 9 months.
milestones: Month 3: Final selection of pilot location and initial facility blueprint.
Month 6: Operational soft launch of the first micro-hub in a test market.

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, low-overhead 'Idea Sandbox' program to introduce structured ideation and rapid prototyping.
Approve seed funding for the AI-Driven Supply Chain Optimization pilot project.
Develop a detailed risk assessment and preliminary business case for the Hyper-Localized Micro-Manufacturing Hub concept.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process leading to ad-hoc, non-scalable problem solving.
Significant internal culture resistance to rapid change and experimentation ('culture' barrier).
Overly conservative budget allocation (12%) relative to the 'bold' risk appetite required for radical growth initiatives.
Siloed decision-making where projects must navigate multiple layers of legal, compliance, and procurement review.
